# openmetadata_glossary_term (Data Source)

Fetches an OpenMetadata Glossary Term by its fully qualified name (e.g. "BusinessGlossary.Revenue" or "BusinessGlossary.Finance.Revenue").

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Glossary terms are looked up by their fully qualified name: Glossary.TermName
# For nested terms use: Glossary.ParentTerm.ChildTerm
data "openmetadata_glossary_term" "revenue" {
  name = "BusinessGlossary.Revenue"
}

output "term_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_glossary_term.revenue.id
}

output "term_glossary" {
  value = data.openmetadata_glossary_term.revenue.glossary
}

output "term_synonyms" {
  value = data.openmetadata_glossary_term.revenue.synonyms
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Fully qualified name of the term, e.g. "Glossary.TermName" or "Glossary.Parent.TermName".

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the term.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name.
- `domains` (List of String) Fully qualified names of domains this term belongs to.
- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name of the term.
- `glossary` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent glossary.
- `id` (String) UUID of the glossary term.
- `mutually_exclusive` (Boolean) Whether child terms are mutually exclusive.
- `owners` (Attributes List) Owners of this term. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owners))
- `parent` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent term, if any.
- `related_terms` (List of String) Fully qualified names of related glossary terms.
- `synonyms` (List of String) Alternate names for this term.

<a id="nestedatt--owners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owners`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) UUID of the owner entity.
- `type` (String) Type of the owner (user or team).
